advantech-icam-540.why: The ICAM-540 runs an Orin NX module, the same Jetson Orin family as the Orin Nano Developer Kit, so what you build on the kit carries over.

advantech-mic-715-ox.name: Advantech MIC-715-OX
advantech-mic-715-ox.why: The MIC-715-OX runs an Orin NX module, the same Jetson Orin family as the Orin Nano Developer Kit.

advantech-mic-733-ao.name: Advantech MIC-733-AO
advantech-mic-733-ao.why: The MIC-733-AO runs Jetson AGX Orin, the same module as the AGX Orin Developer Kit. The smaller Orin Nano kit shares the Orin architecture if you start there.

advantech-tpc-115w.name: Advantech TPC-115W
advantech-tpc-115w.why: The TPC-115W runs NXP i.MX 8M Mini. The i.MX 8M Plus EVK is the closest supported i.MX 8M kit.

compulab-iot-gate-imx8plus.why: The IOT-GATE-iMX8PLUS is built on the CompuLab UCM-i.MX8M-Plus module, the same i.MX 8M Plus as the EVK, so what you build on the kit carries over. Add the gateway's carrier extension when you switch.

onlogic-fr201.why: The FR201 is built on a Raspberry Pi Compute Module 4, the same BCM2711 as the Raspberry Pi 4. A Raspberry Pi 5 also works for early development.

seeed-reterminal.why: The reTerminal is built on a Raspberry Pi Compute Module 4, the same BCM2711 as the Raspberry Pi 4. A Raspberry Pi 5 also works for early development.
